FAQ.question: What counts as one hour?
FAQ.answer: The time translation is switched on, including silence. One hour in both directions counts as one hour, not two.

FAQ.question: Does the other person need to install anything?
FAQ.answer: No. Only you need Diqto Voice.

FAQ.question: Which applications can I use?
FAQ.answer: Teams, Zoom, Google Meet and Webex, on Windows and Mac.

FAQ.question: What if I use all my hours?
FAQ.answer: Diqto Voice lets you know. You can add hours or wait until the following month. Nothing is charged without your agreement.

FAQ.question: Can I cancel whenever I want?
FAQ.answer: Yes. There is no minimum subscription term.
